Goyīcandra
who styles himself Autthāsanika (one to whom when he approaches the court, the king stands up an. offers a seat). He is later than Puruṣottama.
--C. Vivaraṇa on Kramadīśvara's Sam3kṣiptasāra. gr. Adyar D.
